name_reality_gap: Labeled as 'IT Services and IT Consulting' but PwC is primarily an audit, tax, and professional services firm. IT/technology consulting is one component of its advisory practice but does not represent the majority of what PwC does — most revenue and headcount are in audit, tax, and non-IT advisory.
extraction_notes: Three PwC pages all returned good content. Segment weights estimated from PwC's publicly disclosed Global Annual Review 2025 revenue breakdown. PwC operates as a network of legally separate national firms; 'one company' characterizations are structural approximations.
